name: @yottameta/yotta-humanize
description: Yuanzhen (元真) — AI-flavor remover for Chinese writing: a detector engine (24 rule classes + wordlists + statistical burstiness) that identifies and rewrites AI-typical Chinese text to make it read more naturally. Triggers when editing/polishing text, removing AI flavor, or making copy read more human. Boundaries: text-only, deterministic rewrites, no model dependency.
